news.headline: Nifty ends at 23,810 (+1.58%), Sensex +1,225 pts, fourth straight gain
news.what_happened: Nifty 50 closed at 23,810.85 and Sensex at 76,917.85 on 3 Nov, led by FMCG, banks, strong Q2 earnings and easing crude. Midcap 100 +1.06%, Smallcap 100 +0.31%.
news.why_it_matters: After a sharp 4-day run, further upside at the open may be limited; many crude-sensitive and FMCG names already rallied 2-4% yesterday.

news.headline: Crude slips again: WTI $95.35 (-0.77%), Brent $103.07 (-0.51%)
news.what_happened: Oil extended its decline but remains elevated near $95-103 after a recent spike above $107 Brent.
news.why_it_matters: Continued softness helps airlines, tyres and paints on input costs; negative for upstream (ONGC) realizations.

news.headline: Asia weak: Nikkei down ~2-3% on AI/chip-linked selloff, Hang Seng -0.42%
news.what_happened: Nikkei fell sharply (Yahoo -3.15%; one report -1.9% intraday) on tech/AI-linked weakness; Hang Seng slipped 0.42%.
news.why_it_matters: Weak Asian tech sentiment is a mild headwind for Indian IT and risk appetite at the open.

news.headline: US 10Y yield jumps to 4.95% (+1.2%); Wall St still higher
news.why_it_matters: Mildly supportive US close, but rising US yields cap FII appetite for emerging markets.

sector_outlook.reason: Crude tailwind but ASIANPAINT already +4% yesterday
Nasdaq +0.83% offset by Nikkei tech selloff; INR flat; sector weight 0.76x

picks.catalyst: WTI -0.77% / Brent -0.51% overnight, extending the crude decline
picks.logic: Jet fuel is a large share of airline opex; continued crude softness supports margins. Stock already rose 2.1% on 3 Nov, so the target is kept modest.
Synthetic rubber and carbon black are crude derivatives forming a large part of tyre input cost; falling crude eases margin pressure. Less extended than paints (+1.6% on 3 Nov).
